items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Buildings-only policy: theft is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4); clothing/jewellery are personal property not insured (4.3(d)), and property in a conveyance away from the insured location is excluded (4.3(f), 4.5). Not indemnified.
Conveyance and journey-related costs are expressly not insured (4.3(e), 5.2.5, 7.1.8(d)); there is also no insured event. Not indemnified.
